desc:
Welcome to Chess Incremental - incremental game with hundreds of Upgrades,
multiple Prestige layers and tons to unlock! ✨

♟️ The board plays itself - earn Chess every move!
⚡ Buy Upgrades and get Stronger!
💎 Unlock New Currencies!
🍀 Roll Runes and Ranks, then Level them up!
🔥 Prestige and unlock new content!

🎁 Code RELEASE for free Tickets and Potions!
❓ Try to find a SECRET code!
💖 Like + Favorite for Rune Speed and Rune Luck!

Plus Benefits: +10% Chess & +10% Rune Luck
